name: Fisheries Restoration Grant Program (FRGP)

funder.name: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

summary: Annual competitive grants for restoring, enhancing or protecting salmon and steelhead habitat in coastal California watersheds. Nonprofits, Tribes and public agencies can apply; the programme also covers environmental permitting for funded projects.

status.quote: The 2026 FRGP Proposal Solicitation Notice (PSN) is closed.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include state and local government agencies, public entities, Native American Indian Tribes, and nonprofit organizations.

geography.quote: FRGP administers a competitive grant program that has invested millions of dollars to support various projects throughout coastal California.

access.quote: All applications are accepted online through CDFW's WebGrants.

window.quote: The FRGP grant program operates on an annual grant cycle.
